Traffic Advisory

#HooverPD is currently on the scene of a single vehicle accident involving an 18 wheeler at I 65 south MM 253.

The vehicle left the roadway into a wooded area. One fatality has been reported. 2 lanes of I 65 S are open, however there is congestion in the area. https://t.co/PevGsmaoF4

🚦 TRAFFIC ADVISORY 🚦
In view of the Hon’ble President of India’s visit to Hyderabad from 17-12-2025 to 22-12-2025, traffic may be temporarily stopped or diverted at various junctions across the city during specified times due to VVIP/VIP movements.
Commuters are requested to take note of the advisory, plan their travel in advance, and cooperate with traffic personnel on duty.
